contracts.none: Main None grants nothing and removes nothing. Early weapons still get scheduled mastery; species None percentages are editable acquisition propensities, not permanent inability.
contracts.extra: Guaranteed Orc Warrior/etc bonus requires count/type ticket from existing caller and excludes None; helper never invents an extra spin. Freeze again after each actual acquisition.
contracts.mastery: One normal resolution per active owned instance. Weapon Tier1..5 never sets/boosts/gates mastery0..9. Bonuses calculate final-only; Enchant uses final effective mastery and actual compatible definition.
contracts.canon: Named signatures are game adaptations. Receiving an item dispatches no race/hero/archetype/power events or automatic extra abilities; no inherited donor mastery, full character kit, instant stats or preset Enchant.
contracts.duplicates: Different weapon grant sources create distinct instances. No new no-repeat weapon rule; preserve all existing journals and caller-specific uniqueness policies.
contracts.funny: Only authored funny-result outcomes may signal an actual funny spin for existing source-once Shrek hook; None and fixed grants do not become fake funny rolls.
contracts.equalizer: After hard eligibility, every remaining sector including None has equal probability. Overrides lore/tier rarity, species None propensity and Paladin10% anchor; no reweight afterward.
contracts.equalTier: Preserve equal20% per Tier conditional on getting a weapon. Normalize each tier separately after lore and within-tier anchors. All five tiers require at least one eligible weapon; a completely excluded tier needs_configuration.
contracts.affinity: Ordinary soft preferences1..1.6 per source, at most2 combined item weight within each tier. Tagged sword is distinct from dagger/axe. Explicit Paladin reservation retains the earlier about10% target.
contracts.wrappers: Physical host/base/origin priors compose once. Select one most-specific behavioral overlay per actual wrapper source. No prey/army/companion/mentor/external mecha or full-animal transformation becomes owner weapon evidence.
